topic: GLP-1 demand, supply bottlenecks, and value capture
capture_method: curator-frozen extracts plus unadjusted market observations

extracts: Q1 2024 revenue rose 26%; new-product revenue increased by $1.79 billion to $2.39 billion, led by Mounjaro and Zepbound.
Lilly raised full-year revenue guidance by $2 billion while still describing supply constraints and a manufacturing expansion plan.
Novo Nordisk announced results for the first three months of 2024 and showed continued obesity-care growth.
Its investor material described a gradual increase in Wegovy supply rather than unconstrained availability.
Novo Nordisk agreed to acquire three fill-finish sites from Novo Holdings after Novo Holdings' planned Catalent acquisition.
Closing depended on the Catalent transaction and approvals; additional filling capacity was expected gradually from 2026 onward.
Novo Holdings agreed to acquire Catalent for $63.50 per share; three fill-finish sites were intended for sale to Novo Nordisk.
The announced price represented a 16.5% premium to Catalent's February 2 close and 47.5% to its 60-day VWAP.
